_note: Approximate coordinates for well-known settlements and trail points in the valleys below the monitored lakes. Positions are rounded and indicative, not survey-grade. 'basins' lists the upstream river basins whose water passes this place, used to relate a settlement to lakes in the same river system. This is a river-system + elevation relationship, NOT a hydraulic flood model.
